annotations.title: Explain an airline fare basis code

description: US airline tickets, how to read them: explain a fare basis code (for example KL7NR3). Returns the booking class from the first letter (with a note when the code suggests otherwise, such as UP upgrade fares), labeled notes that match the rest of the code (detail 'full' lists every convention), and a tip to paste the fare rules from your own booking for exact change and refund terms. Tax codes are not covered. Input: only the fare basis code, an optional airline code and the optional detail level; names, confirmation codes, ticket numbers and frequent flyer numbers aren't needed or used.

airline.description: Optional 2-character airline code, for example AA, DL, UA or B6.

detail.description: Optional. "brief" (default) gives the main facts; "full" adds every note we have.

fare_basis.description: The fare basis code only, 1 to 15 characters.

name: explain_fare_basis
